tbc-r1-f1.rationale: Revision applied. T7 Depends-on now states the conditional ordering ('T6 always; T10 and T12 invoked per-task inside the batch loop') and T7 Notes documents the per-task signal flow (read manifest closing-decision after each gate, pause on first failure). The unstated ordering assumption is now stated; a fresh implementer can wire the failure-path pause handler to the per-gate signal source without inferring.
